name: saas-idea-brainstorm
description: Autonomous SaaS idea validation pipeline: takes a raw idea through framing, competitive scan, market validation, feasibility verification, positioning, MVP scope lock, and a post-LOCK implementation blueprint (feature specs, field-level schema, UX, interface contracts, NFRs, test and build plans) so build starts with no product decision left to invent. Produces a Validated, Hypothesis, or Pre-feasibility MVP Pack with strictly graded evidence (A/B/C/D), then a build-ready blueprint locked at gate BP. Post-LOCK maintenance: declare drift any time, reconcile on demand against declared or observed product reality, and route unvalidated changes to scoped validation runs or a new cycle. Analysis mode runs with no integrations; user-installed MCP servers/CLIs (scraping, hosting, analytics, payments, email) unlock higher-autonomy rungs after authenticated probes.

ads_budget_cap_usd.title: Paid-traffic budget cap in USD (optional)
ads_budget_cap_usd.description: Hard planning cap for paid-traffic experiments in market-evidence mode. Enforced by the pipeline's outward-action policy (budget preflight + journaled spends), not by ad platforms. 0 (default) disables all paid traffic.
